{
  "findings": [
    {
      "title": "Inconsistent sample size between synopsis and statistical plan",
      "quote": "Approximately 156 patients (65 patients per arm) will be enrolled",
      "page": 27,
      "section": "Population",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "critical",
      "explanation": "The synopsis states approximately 156 patients (65 per arm) but the statistical plan states approximately 130 patients (65 per arm). This is a direct numerical inconsistency that affects sample size and power calculations.",
      "fix": "Reconcile the sample size in the synopsis and statistical plan to a single consistent number."
    },
    {
      "title": "Primary objective lacks estimand specification",
      "quote": "The primary objective of the study is to assess the efficacy of dupilumab on skin lesions in patients with atopic hand and foot dermatitis.",
      "page": 25,
      "section": "Objectives",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The primary objective is vague and does not specify the estimand (population, endpoint, intercurrent event strategy, etc.) as required by ICH M11 and SPIRIT 2025.",
      "fix": "Define the estimand for the primary endpoint, including the intercurrent event handling strategy."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing trial schema",
      "quote": "Thin or missing sections: M11 1.2 Trial Schema (missing)",
      "page": 25,
      "section": "Trial Schema",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The protocol lacks a trial schema figure, which is essential for visualizing the study design and visit schedule.",
      "fix": "Add a trial schema diagram showing screening, treatment, and follow-up periods with key assessments."
    },
    {
      "title": "Contraception and pregnancy information missing",
      "quote": "M11 5.4 Contraception (missing)",
      "page": 25,
      "section": "Contraception",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "critical",
      "explanation": "The protocol does not specify contraception requirements for participants of childbearing potential, which is a critical safety and ethical requirement.",
      "fix": "Add a detailed contraception section including acceptable methods, duration, and pregnancy testing requirements."
    },
    {
      "title": "Trial stopping rules not defined",
      "quote": "M11 4.3 Trial Stopping Rules (missing)",
      "page": 25,
      "section": "Trial Stopping Rules",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The protocol does not describe any stopping rules for the trial, such as safety or futility criteria, which is essential for trial oversight.",
      "fix": "Include a section on trial stopping rules, including criteria for early termination due to safety or efficacy concerns."
    },
    {
      "title": "Access to trial intervention after end of trial not addressed",
      "quote": "M11 4.5 Access to Trial Intervention After End of Trial (missing)",
      "page": 25,
      "section": "Access to Trial Intervention",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The protocol does not state whether participants will have access to dupilumab after the trial ends, which is an ethical consideration.",
      "fix": "Add a statement about post-trial access to the investigational product or alternative treatment."
    },
    {
      "title": "Inconsistent dosing for adolescents",
      "quote": "In adolescents: Body weight ≥60 kg, dupilumab 300 mg, after a loading dose of 600 mg on day 1, body weight <60 kg, dupilumab 200 mg, after a loading dose of 400 mg on day 1",
      "page": 27,
      "section": "Treatments",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The adolescent dosing is described in the synopsis but the body text (not provided) may not match; also, the synopsis does not specify the dosing for adolescents in the study design section, leading to potential confusion.",
      "fix": "Ensure the adolescent dosing is consistently described in all relevant sections of the protocol."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing data sharing and patient/public involvement sections",
      "quote": "SPIRIT 6 Data sharing (missing)",
      "page": 25,
      "section": "Data Sharing",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "The protocol lacks a data sharing statement and patient/public involvement section, which are required by SPIRIT 2025.",
      "fix": "Add sections on data sharing and patient/public involvement."
    }
  ]
}
